title: La narration : le remède naturel pour votre mémoire après 60 ans
description:
Dear French learner over 60,

You're looking for your keys. A word escapes you. You walk into a room and forget why you came…
These little memory lapses are common after 60. But they are not inevitable, and they are not the beginning of something to fear.

In this video, I explain what is really happening in your brain after 60, and I share one of the most powerful — and most enjoyable — tools to strengthen your memory naturally: narration.

Not grammar. Not flashcards. Not memory exercises.

Just a story, listened to with care, and then retold in your own words.

In this video:

⭐ Why these little lapses happen after 60 — and why they are completely normal
⭐ What narration is and why it is the most natural memory exercise that exists
⭐ What happens in your brain when you retell a story
⭐ A simple, playful practice to try today, no preparation needed!

A new French story every Saturday on this channel — free, gentle, and made for you.
